author: nflaig
content:
`ethpandaops/lodestar:deathstar` has these two features now but those are mutually exclusive, also other `deathstar` features need to be disabled, so this image is a honest node by default, every adversarial feature is behind a feature flag
- `--adversarial.reorg.buildOnEmpty=true`: always builds on the `EMPTY` parent variant, attempting to orphan the parent execution payload
- `--adversarial.reorg.omitPtcAttestations=true`: omits the parent slot’s PTC attestations when building on `EMPTY`. Intended to be combined with `buildOnEmpty`
- `--adversarial.reorg.delayLastSlotProposal=true`: delays the epoch’s final-slot (31) block so it becomes a late, weak head that the next proposer can reorg
- `--adversarial.reorg.lastSlotProposalDelayBps=4000`: sets the delay to 40% into the slot. Only applies when `delayLastSlotProposal` is enabled
- `--adversarial.reorg.buildOnParentInLastSlot=true`: makes the final-slot proposer build on the current head’s parent, directly orphaning the current head

cc <@577788234810130432> or whoever can roll this out on the devnet, we want to test `delayLastSlotProposal` for now, I did a local kurtosis run with lighthouse and indeed it does those reorgs across the epoch boundry, but this might take a while to show up on the devnet, we need deathstar to be a proposer at slot 31 and also lighthouse to be the next proposer at slot 0
